_readme: Metadata for config/balance.json: what each key means, its unit and its allowed range. The loader checks every value against this file and the reference table docs/game/BALANCE_REFERENCE.md is generated from it (godot --headless --path godot --script res://tools/config_docs.gd). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.

display.doc: Name shown in the UI for this role.

weapon.doc: Weapon tag used by the presentation (sword model/clips).

radius.doc: Body radius of the fighter; used for collisions and hit tests.

armor.doc: Share of incoming damage that is ignored (0.25 = takes 25% less damage).

poise.doc: How much poise damage the fighter absorbs before it is staggered. Higher = harder to interrupt.

poise_regen_per_tick.doc: Poise regained each tick once the regen delay has passed.

poise_regen_delay.doc: Ticks after the last hit before poise starts to regenerate.

stagger_immunity_ticks.doc: Ticks of stagger immunity after recovering from a stagger (stops stun-locking).

stamina_regen_per_tick.doc: Stamina regained each tick when not spending it.

stamina_regen_delay.doc: Ticks after spending stamina before regeneration resumes.

sprint_drain_per_tick.doc: Stamina spent each tick while sprinting.

block_arc_deg.doc: Width of the arc in front of the fighter in which blocking works.

block_cost_mult.doc: Stamina cost multiplier when blocking a hit (lower = cheaper blocks).

block_move_mult.doc: Move speed multiplier while holding block.

guardbreak_stun.doc: Stun time when the guard is broken.

parry_arc_deg.doc: Width of the arc in which a parry works.

parry_cost.doc: Stamina spent to attempt a parry.

parry_refund.doc: Stamina given back on a successful parry.

parry_recovery_ticks.doc: Recovery time after a parry attempt.

parry_stagger_ticks.doc: How long a successfully parried attacker is staggered.

parry_window_bonus.doc: Extra ticks added to the parry timing window (bigger = more forgiving).

riposte_mult.doc: Damage multiplier of the counter-attack right after a successful parry.

riposte_ticks.doc: How long the riposte bonus lasts.

dodge_cost.doc: Stamina spent by a dodge roll.

dodge_distance.doc: Distance covered by a dodge roll.

dodge_ticks.doc: Total length of a dodge roll.

dodge_iframe_start.doc: Tick of the dodge at which invulnerability starts.

dodge_iframe_end.doc: Tick of the dodge at which invulnerability ends.

hit_react_ticks.doc: Length of the flinch animation lock after a light hit that does not break poise.

turn_free.doc: Turn speed when not locked on and not attacking.

turn_locked.doc: Turn speed while locked on to the opponent.

turn_attack_startup.doc: Turn speed during an attack's wind-up (free camera).

turn_attack_startup_locked.doc: Turn speed during an attack's wind-up (locked on).

attack_steer_startup.doc: How much movement input steers during an attack wind-up.

attack_steer_other.doc: How much movement input steers during the rest of an attack.

parry_steer.doc: How much movement input steers during a parry.

kind.doc: What the ability does: buff, attack, blink or counter.

role.doc: Role that owns the ability (must have a profile).

cast_ticks.doc: Cast time before the effect starts.

stamina_cost.doc: Stamina spent when the ability is used.

hp_threshold.doc: Health fraction at or below which the ability is allowed (0 = always).

combo_length.doc: Number of hits in an ability combo.

guard_cost_mult.doc: Guard stamina cost multiplier while the ability is active.

guard_unbreakable.doc: If true the guard cannot be broken while the ability is active.

poise_mult.doc: Poise multiplier while the ability is active.

blink_tick.doc: Tick of the cast at which the blink happens.

iframe_ticks.doc: Invulnerability ticks granted by the ability.

counter_start.doc: Tick at which a counter stance starts to catch hits.

counter_end.doc: Tick at which a counter stance stops catching hits.

counter_stagger_ticks.doc: Stagger applied to the attacker that hits a counter stance.

stance_move_mult.doc: Move speed multiplier while in the stance.

stance_turn_mult.doc: Turn speed multiplier while in the stance.

experimental.doc: True = the ability is refused unless a caller opts in (the King).

id.doc: Identifier of the attack (used in logs and tests).

animation.doc: Animation tag the presentation plays for this attack.

combo_index.doc: Position in the light-attack chain (0 = first).

absolute_ticks.doc: Fixed total length in ticks (0 = derive from the role's contract light/heavy ticks and ticks_scale).

hitstun_ticks.doc: Base hit stun the victim suffers; multiplied by hit_stun.*_mult.

guard_break.doc: 1 = this attack always breaks a raised guard.

startup_end.doc: Where the wind-up ends and the active frames begin.

cancel_from.doc: From here the attack can be cancelled into the next action.

forward_motion_m.doc: Distance the fighter lunges forward during the attack.

damage_mult.doc: Multiplier on the contract base damage.

guard_cost_mult.doc: Multiplier on the blocker's stamina cost.

poise_damage.doc: Poise damage dealt to the victim.

arc_degrees.doc: Width of the hit arc (narrower = needs more aim).

ticks_scale.doc: Scales the attack's length relative to the contract ticks (higher = slower).

near_m.doc: Distance below which near_mult applies (Bishop beam is weaker up close).

far_m.doc: Distance above which far_mult applies (Bishop beam is stronger at range).

tuning_id.doc: Name of this tuning. It is part of the stamp: client and server must match.

schema.doc: File format version. Do not change.

hit_stun.light_mult.doc: Hit stun multiplier for a clean light hit.

hit_stun.heavy_mult.doc: Hit stun multiplier for a heavy (charged) hit; keep above light_mult.

hit_stun.ability_mult.doc: Hit stun multiplier for an ability hit.

pacing.comeback.hp_gap.doc: A fighter this far behind on health gets the comeback damage bonus.

pacing.comeback.damage_mult.doc: Damage multiplier of the comeback bonus.

pacing.sudden_death.start_s.doc: Seconds of fighting after which every blow starts to grow.

pacing.sudden_death.ramp_per_s.doc: Damage growth per second once sudden death has started.

duel_length.damage_scale.doc: Global HP-damage scale used for every pairing without its own entry.

duel_length.target_seconds.doc: Target duel length the per-pair scales were calibrated for (informational).

duel_length.pairs.*.doc: Per pairing (attacker role + defender role) damage scale that brings a duel to the target length.

attacker_edge.target.doc: Win rate the table was calibrated for (informational, bots only).

attacker_edge.stamina.attacker_cost.doc: Attacker's stamina cost multiplier (1 = neutral, lower = cheaper).

attacker_edge.stamina.defender_cost.doc: Defender's stamina cost multiplier (1 = neutral, higher = costlier).

attacker_edge.stamina.defender_regen.doc: Defender's stamina regeneration multiplier (1 = neutral, lower = slower).

attacker_edge.pairs.*.doc: [attacker damage x, defender damage x] for one pairing; at most one side may be above 1. Edit it in the matrix form (attacker_edge.matrix[attacker][defender]).
